action: A four-legged animal stands facing left with its head raised, collapses into a tangle in frame 3, then reappears facing right and walks toward the bucket, lowering its head to sniff near the ground.
identity_gap: Frames 1, 2 and 6-8 keep the doodle's boxy head with an eye, long neck, rectangular body and separate straight-line legs, so they read as the same drawing. Frame 3 breaks the drawing apart (head detached at lower left, legs scattered) and frame 5 squashes the body into a short hunched shape that no longer matches the doodle's proportions.
notes: The film dog turns from facing left to facing right around frames 3-4, and the animation handles that turn by falling apart and then flipping in one jump. The change that would help most is a proper turn in frames 3-5 that keeps the head, neck, body and legs connected while the figure rotates, instead of a collapse followed by a mirror flip.
